_comment: FRAMED PAGES (owner 2026-10-22, final shape): every app and map has its own page inside the site frame at /<kind>/<slug>/ - `kind` is `apps` or `maps` (the folder), `slug` the folder name: /apps/moontower/, /maps/budget/ ... `app` is what plays inside it (a page, or a PDF: point `app` at a .pdf in the folder and the window shows it). Every report in apps/reports/reports.json is a SHOPPING APP at /apps/<id>/ (`reportsKind`), a real page on the /shopmap/ engine, not a framed one. Run `node tools/make-pages.js` after adding one to create its folder. /apps/ and /maps/ list everything of that kind (list.js). The hamburger menu (owner 2026-10-22, evening; reshaped 2026-10-24): Apps opens to `categories` (in this order), each app's or map's `category` places it there (Budget, Datacenter and AISD sit under Metro Apps; `kind` only decides the folder of its framed page), all reports go under `reportsCategory`; Content opens to a Maps group (the /maps/ directory plus any map whose `category` is not an Apps category) followed by the `content` links (an entry with an empty `url` shows greyed until the address is filled in). There is no top-level Maps section any more. Every category listed shows even while empty, so the structure is visible.
